name: code-analyzer
description: Code intelligence platform — knowledge graph analysis, PR review, and cross-repo intelligence for AI agents
author: Lambertyan

scripts.bench:density: node scripts/pool-density.mjs benchmarks/martian-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --budget 5 --split-half --json benchmarks/pool-density.json && node scripts/pool-density.mjs benchmarks/martian-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --budget 5 --group category --split-half --json benchmarks/pool-density-category.json
scripts.docs:agentic: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.tests.json tsx scripts/agentic-tools.ts --check && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.tests.json tsx scripts/agentic-tools.ts --self-test
scripts.docs:permissions: TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.tests.json tsx scripts/agentic-permissions.ts --check && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.tests.json tsx scripts/agentic-permissions.ts --self-test && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.tests.json tsx scripts/agentic-permissions.ts --dry-run
scripts.bench:lane-discovery: node scripts/lane-discovery.mjs --arm benchmarks/martian-reviewer-bench.json --reference benchmarks/martian-wide-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --budget 5 --without crosscheck --json benchmarks/lane-discovery.json && node scripts/lane-discovery.mjs --arm benchmarks/martian-wide-bench.json --reference benchmarks/martian-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --budget 5 --json benchmarks/lane-discovery-wide.json
scripts.bench:cut-curve: node scripts/cut-curve.mjs benchmarks/aacr-bench.json --split-half --json benchmarks/cut-curve-aacr.json && node scripts/cut-curve.mjs benchmarks/martian-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile all --split-half --json benchmarks/cut-curve-martian.json && node scripts/cut-curve.mjs benchmarks/martian-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --split-half --json benchmarks/cut-curve-martian-core.json && node scripts/cut-curve.mjs benchmarks/martian-wide-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile all --split-half --json benchmarks/cut-curve-wide-martian.json && node scripts/cut-curve.mjs benchmarks/martian-wide-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --split-half --json benchmarks/cut-curve-wide-martian-core.json
scripts.bench:same-cut: node scripts/same-cut.mjs --ours benchmarks/cut-curve-wide-martian-core.json --theirs benchmarks/aacr/competitor-baseline.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --json benchmarks/same-cut-core.json && node scripts/same-cut.mjs --ours benchmarks/cut-curve-wide-martian.json --theirs benchmarks/aacr/competitor-baseline.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile all --json benchmarks/same-cut-all.json
scripts.bench:score-floor: node scripts/score-floor.mjs --artifact benchmarks/martian-bench.json --baseline benchmarks/aacr/competitor-baseline.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --k 5 --json benchmarks/score-floor-k5.json && node scripts/score-floor.mjs --artifact benchmarks/martian-bench.json --baseline benchmarks/aacr/competitor-baseline.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --k 12 --json benchmarks/score-floor-k12.json
scripts.bench:symbol-adjacency: node scripts/symbol-adjacency.mjs --arm benchmarks/martian-wide-bench.json --reference benchmarks/aacr/competitor-baseline.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --budget 5 --changed benchmarks/martian/changed-lines.json --json benchmarks/symbol-adjacency.json
scripts.bench:symbol-crosscheck:record: node scripts/symbol-crosscheck.mjs --arm benchmarks/martian-wide-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --budget 5 --mode record --out benchmarks/symbol-crosscheck.json
scripts.bench:symbol-crosscheck: node scripts/symbol-crosscheck.mjs --arm benchmarks/martian-wide-bench.json --corpus benchmarks/martian/positive_samples.json --profile core --budget 5 --mode replay --out benchmarks/symbol-crosscheck.json
